title: The War Question: Dueling Master Thesis (Spread Track)
statement: Paired duel track — confidence score = SPREAD, not probability. Thesis A (Interlocking-Theater Escalation, see interlocking-theater-escalation.json, 57): the turning manifests as real, sustained external war; fronts genuinely ignite each other. Thesis B (the Potemkin War, named for effect not intent): external war posture is theater — loud but shallow, sustained for narrative cover and emergency powers — then collapses into internal struggle; the real war is domestic. NOTE: the two theses are not opposites — both terminate in internal struggle; they differ only on route. Scores measure mechanism support from different evidence bases: A is anchored in seven months of escalation receipts; B is currently structure and incentive inference with few positive receipts. The spread (currently +9 toward A) is what moves; each of the three tells shifts it.
evidence_confirmed: November Pause logic already observed: regime incentive to keep external fronts quiet into midterms — consistent with war-as-theater rather than war-as-commitment
Divergent interests (Sept 8): Israel needs escalation, America needs quiet — the US side of that divergence is the Feint signature
Houthi Red Sea fork (76, logged 2026-09-11): resource-strain prong vs noise-without-commitment prong is now a live discriminator between the two theses
Domestic enforcement groundwork track running in parallel: apparatus pre-built for the internal landing regardless of external outcome
evidence_contradicted: Real resource commitments already exist: Hormuz convoy escort operations, ten tankers destroyed, month seven of the Iran war — the war is not purely theatrical
SPR runway track (82) treats the oil shock as a genuine fatality mechanism; a pure feint would not generate real scarcity dynamics
Escalation traps, once sprung, do not respect theatrical intent — Pape's escalation logic can force genuine commitment on an unwilling regime
falsifier: The duel resolves: if force posture, budgets, and casualty exposure stay flat while rhetoric spikes and domestic enforcement outpaces war spending through Q4 2026, B dominates and A weakens. If external theaters generate sustained verifiable resource commitment (permanent carrier repositioning, war appropriations exceeding domestic enforcement growth, a front the regime cannot de-escalate), A dominates and B dies. The spread collapses toward 0 only if the wire stays genuinely mixed — which is itself the honest forecast state.
forward_watchlist: TELL 1 — FORCE POSTURE: carrier group repositioning orders vs. home-port holding during the next rhetoric spike (A move: repositioning; B move: holding)

TELL 2 — BUDGET: FY27 supplementary war appropriations vs. DHS/ICE domestic enforcement line-item growth (the cleanest single metric — money is the one thing a Potemkin cannot fake for long; B signature = domestic wins)
TELL 3 — HOUTHI FORK: does the Red Sea theater (houthi-red-sea-escalation-fork, 76) draw real fleet assets (A) or strikes/statements with flat posture (B)?
SPREAD WATCH: log each tell movement to the mget_ledger as a duel-read; the spread is the forecast, not either thesis
LANDING CONVERGENCE: whichever thesis wins, watch the domestic apparatus activate — both routes terminate in internal struggle
Inversion twin: 9-11-inversion-false-flag (35) supplies the ignition; the Potemkin thesis supplies the sustained posture if B wins the route
